Class PlayerStatusDTO

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.dto.PlayerStatusDTO
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PlayerStatusDTO extends Object implements Serializable
Carries the boolean status flags and active discounts for a single player.

Sent by the server whenever any of these flags changes so that the client can update the relevant UI indicators.
